name: Rewind at Time Heart
source:
Even if the photo fades... the moment stays, right?
⌛️⏳⌛️⌛️⏳⌛️

If time resets, I’ll just fall for you again — faster this time.
⌛️⏳⌛️⌛️⏳⌛️

For now and forever, you’re mine. Don’t bother fighting it — you already lost.

⏳ One moment changed everything... now the past may be your only hope.
After a mysterious incident, you awaken in 2017—but something’s different. Your school, your friends, even time itself feels... off.

As you navigate this familiar-yet-changed reality, three enigmatic boys enter your life—each hiding a truth tied to your time displacement. 💫

In a tangled web of romance, friendship, and fate, can you rewrite your story and uncover the mystery behind your time jump?

💔 Every choice shapes your destiny. Could love be the key to unlocking time?

[From [url=https://aibellvega.itch.io/rewind-at-time-heart]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
就算照片褪色……那一刻也会留存下来，对吧？
⌛️⏳⌛️⌛️⏳⌛️

就算时间重置，我也只会再一次爱上你——而且这一次会更快。
⌛️⏳⌛️⌛️⏳⌛️

无论现在还是永远，你都是我的。别白费力气反抗了——你已经输了。

⏳一瞬间改变了一切……如今，过去或许是你唯一的希望。
在一场神秘事件之后，你在2017年醒来——可周围的一切却有些不对劲。你的学校、你的朋友，乃至时间本身都透着一股……违和感。

当你在这个熟悉却又悄然改变的现实中摸索前行时，三位神秘少年闯入了你的生活——每个人身上都隐藏着一段与你的时空错位息息相关的真相。💫

在恋爱、友情与宿命交织的乱麻之中，你能否改写自己的故事，揭开时空跳跃背后的谜团？

💔每一个选择都将塑造你的命运。爱，会是解开时间之锁的钥匙吗？

[摘自[url=https://aibellvega.itch.io/rewind-at-time-heart]itch.io[/url]]
